nodes.label: Calculation types / INCAR templates
nodes.rationale: --calc-type picks a pre-validated example/INCAR_<type>; a case-supplied INCAR always takes precedence, editable without Python.

nodes.label: Quantum ESPRESSO engine (engine: qe)
nodes.rationale: VASP needs a paid licence; QE (pw.x) is free and runs the same cases. The VASP env_setup is NOT sourced for QE because an Intel mpirun first on PATH would run an OpenMPI-built pw.x as N duplicate serial jobs; use qe_env_setup instead.

nodes.label: Generic ASE-calculator engine (engine: ase)
nodes.rationale: Drives any ASE calculator (EMT, DMol3, GPAW, MACE...); writes a self-contained run_ase.py + ase_calc.json so the job dir re-runs without vasp_auto, and emt is the default so the engine is testable anywhere.

nodes.label: Spin-polarised runs (--spin/--magmom)
nodes.rationale: --spin sets ISPIN=2 and derives MAGMOM from POSCAR composition; a MAGMOM already in the case INCAR is kept.

nodes.label: KPOINTS generation
nodes.rationale: --kmesh/--kspacing/--kpath with presets cubic/fcc/bcc/hex; --kpath auto detects lattice type in pure Python (no spglib) and errors on low-symmetry cells.

nodes.label: Workflow chaining (chained steps)
nodes.rationale: Outputs feed forward automatically (CONTCAR->POSCAR, CHGCAR for dos/bands). Priority: --workflow flag > case workflow.yaml > config workflow key. A leading converge step carries ENCUT/SIGMA/NELM/k-mesh into later steps.

nodes.label: Convergence scans (ENCUT/SIGMA/NELM/KPOINTS)
nodes.rationale: Sequential stages ENCUT->SIGMA->NELM->KPOINTS, each holding the selected value fixed. SIGMA picks the largest smearing whose T*S stays below sigma-tol (standard VASP guidance); --reuse-wavecar seeds each trial to cut wall time.

nodes.label: Structure building (pure Python + ASE)
nodes.rationale: Pure-Python operators (supercell/vacancy/substitute/interstitial/adsorbate/freeze/scale-cell) compose in command-line order; ASE-backed builders add bulk/slab/molecule/crystal/nanotube/CIF import.

nodes.label: ML pre-relaxation (OMat24/UMA)
nodes.rationale: MLIP minima sit within a few meV/atom of the PBE minimum, so the subsequent VASP relaxation converges in a fraction of the ionic steps; default backend is Meta FAIR UMA/OMat24 via fairchem-core, emt for a no-install demo.

nodes.label: Remote run over SSH (--remote)
nodes.rationale: run_mode ssh rsyncs inputs and runs mpirun synchronously; slurm/pbs submit sbatch/qsub over SSH then exit. env_setup is sourced before mpirun for non-interactive toolchains (Intel oneAPI/modules).

nodes.label: Offload mode (run_mode: ssh_detached)
nodes.rationale: Full engine runs on the remote under setsid so it covers iterative paths (convergence, chained workflows) and the laptop can power off; ships POSCAR + a pre-built POTCAR so the remote needs no POTCAR library.

nodes.label: Excel results summary
nodes.rationale: Styled xlsx with energy, convergence flag, Fermi, band gap, forces, pressure, magnetisation, NEB barriers, ionic steps, detected errors and queue job id, plus a per-case energy bar chart.

nodes.label: Self-check (fake VASP binaries)
nodes.rationale: 41 checks with fake mpirun/vasp_std/sbatch verify every feature on any machine in seconds without VASP or a cluster; everything it writes stays inside selfcheck/.

nodes.label: Implicit solvation (VASPsol)
nodes.rationale: --solvation injects LSOL=.TRUE. + EB_K; requires a VASPsol-patched binary or VASP aborts on the unknown LSOL tag.

nodes.label: Automatic error recovery (--auto-retry)
nodes.rationale: Known errors with a safe INCAR fix (EDDDAV->ALGO=All, RHOSYG->ISYM=0) are re-run up to N times; errors without a safe generic fix (TOO FEW BANDS) are never auto-fixed. Local scheduler only.

nodes.label: Web UI (vasp-auto-ui)
nodes.rationale: Separate stdlib-only package (http.server, binds 127.0.0.1) that calls the same engine functions as the CLI and launches runs through the CLI itself, so behaviour is identical; Build/Calculate/Workflow/Results tabs plus an OpenAI-compatible AI builder that only chooses the build command.

nodes.label: Combine two structures (deposition/heterostructure)
nodes.rationale: --combine stacks a guest on a host (default stack keeps host in-plane lattice; --combine-strain for epitaxy; insert mode drops guest atoms into the unchanged host cell).

nodes.label: Cell matching (--match-cells)
nodes.rationale: Searches commensurate supercell pairs bringing incommensurate host/guest into registry and prints strain per axis; large strain/angle means combine without --combine-strain.

nodes.label: Prototype crystals library
nodes.rationale: Pure-Python built-in library (graphene, graphite, rutile/anatase-TiO2, hBN) for compounds ASE's bulk() cannot build.

nodes.label: Retry failed (--retry-failed)
nodes.rationale: Reruns only unconverged cases: CONTCAR becomes the new POSCAR, WAVECAR/CHGCAR are kept as the SCF seed. Safe to repeat; the UI Resume button is the equivalent with an editable INCAR spreadsheet.

hyperedges.label: converge to relax to scf to dos pipeline
